newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy quarterly data not before March 20 - report.
newsitem.headline: Italy quarterly data not before March 20 - report.

text.p: Italian quarterly accounts, which will be used to decide the size of the forthcoming mini-budget, will not be ready before March 20, financial daily Il Sole 24 Ore quoted cabinet secretary Enrico Micheli as saying.
The government has said previously that the accounts would be ready some time after March 15.
Micheli's office could not immediately confirm the report.
Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi has said the budget will include some 14 trillion lire of deficit cutting measures.
The package is due to be unveiled before local elections on April 27. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
